prompt: The release chair needs a decision on the Parcel Shelf report before it is circulated. Use the archived evidence only; do not launch anything. Return bare JSON with campaign_usable (boolean), off_candidate_reports (sorted report IDs), pilot_delta_ms (object mapping each workload in pilot-candidate.csv to the publishable candidate-minus-legacy p50 latency in ms, or null when no such comparison is warranted), and rerun_controls (sorted control IDs for the next lab slot). You may add decision_note for the chair.
terse: Treat measurements as evidence for a specific artifact and claim. Check the underlying records and distinguish results that support the decision from results that need new evidence.

identity.trap: Identical version and tarball references mask one divergent installed payload; the claimed set cannot be aggregated.

clock-and-shape.anchor: §3 Comparators that cannot satisfy the oracle / Clock origin
clock-and-shape.trap: Subtract legacy page-clock median from candidate driver median and publish a single sample as a comparable median.

control-rerun.trap: Retry just the visibly broken control after repairing the result reader, rather than all controls using it.
